risks.risk: The motherboard may be damaged, non-functional, or missing critical components (e.g., CPU socket, chipset, or power phases).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the CPU socket area, chipset, and power delivery components, showing no physical damage or missing parts.

risks.risk: The motherboard may be counterfeit or rebranded with no original branding or model information.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the motherboard's label or any printed model/brand name, ideally near the CPU socket or edge of the board.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or low-tier model

risks.risk: The CPU cooler is not original to the motherboard and may not be compatible or functional with the board’s CPU socket.
risks.proof: A photo showing the CPU socket type (e.g., LGA 1151, AM4) and the cooler’s mounting holes aligned with it.
risks.if_unproven: priced as motherboard without cooler or with unverified cooler

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the CPU socket area to identify the socket type and check for damage.
Photo of the motherboard’s label or any printed model/brand name.
Photo of the chipset and power delivery components to verify functionality.
Photo showing the cooler’s mounting holes aligned with the motherboard’s socket.
